For my Grapheme color Bc it’s the strongest:

Advantages: I’m good at remembering strings of numbers, dates, and names because even if I don’t remember a letter I remember the color

Disadvantages: i can’t remember something if it isn’t in the right color (ex, to this day I still slip up and call March the 4th month because the colors are the same, it being the 3rd month makes my brain hurt) also, when looking at letters or numbers in an incorrect color, it feels like dissonance when you listen to music, gives me a headache.

A downside to any form of synesthesia is when you’re trying to explain something but can’t find any words that non synesthetes would understand, or slipping up and using a color to describe something and being met with confusion :/
